items.title: the tiny-text reveal
items.body: people put SUPER tiny text on screen so you have to pause and zoom in to read it. it works on me every time, i fall for it.

items.title: "money can't buy happiness, but..."
items.body: people finish the line with their little luxury, like a fancy coffee, a manicure, a weekend away. it's a whole montage of treat yourself.

items.title: reverse-audio cinematic edits
items.body: reversed audio and dramatic movie-trailer edits for totally normal stuff like making coffee or opening a package. the drama!!

items.title: "reasons why you don't need to..."
items.body: fake advice videos with muffled audio where the reasons are so weak they don't talk anyone out of anything. it's the joke.

items.title: "scuba"
items.body: a dance that means something smells bad: you hold your nose and fan the air. it was one of google's most-searched teen slang terms this year.

items.title: "crine"
items.body: a misspelling of "crying" on purpose. it means laughing so hard. also on google's most-searched list.

items.title: "clanker"
items.body: the kids' insult for a robot or AI. like if a chatbot gives a bad answer: "ugh, clanker."

items.title: "tuff"
items.body: means cool or impressive. "that jacket is tuff."
